Rivne Football Club "Veres-Rivne" (26.67%) | chrtitle = General Director | chairman = Anton Nazaruk[https://nkveres.com/menedzhment Менеджмент]. nkveres.com | manager = [[Oleh Shandruk]] | league = [[Ukrainian Premier League]] | season = [[2025–26 Ukrainian Premier League|2025–26]] | position = Ukrainian Premier League, 11th of 16 | website = {{url|https://nkveres.com/}} | current = 2022–23 NK Veres Rivne season | pattern_la1 = _veresrivne2122h | pattern_b1 = _veresrivne2122h | pattern_ra1 = _veresrivne2122h | leftarm1 = FF0000 | body1 = FF0000 | rightarm1 = FF0000 | shorts1 = FF0000 | socks1 = FF0000 | pattern_la2 = _rprijedor2122a | pattern_b2 = _rprijedor2122a | pattern_ra2 = _rprijedor2122a | leftarm2 = 000000 | body2 = 000000 | rightarm2 = 000000 | shorts2 = 000000 | socks2 = 000000 | pattern_la3 = _veresrivne2122t | pattern_b3 = _veresrivne2122t | pattern_ra3 = _veresrivne2122t | leftarm3 = FFFFFF | body3 = FFFFFF | rightarm3 = FFFFFF | shorts3 = FFFFFF | socks3 = FFFFFF }} '''Narodnyy Klub Veres Rivne''' ({{langx|uk|РНК «Верес»}}) is a [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Rivne]]. The club competes in the [[Ukrainian Premier League]], the top tier of [[Ukrainian football]], after winning the [[2020–21 Ukrainian First League]]. Their home stadium until 2017 was [[Avanhard Stadium (Rivne)|Avanhard Stadium]] in [[Rivne]]. From that time, till September 2022 the club played its home matches at [[Avanhard Stadium (Lutsk)|Avanhard Stadium]] in [[Lutsk]]. Since September 2022, all home matches are played in partially renovated [[Avanhard Stadium (Rivne)|Avanhard Stadium]]. Founded in 1957, Veres first promoted to [[Ukrainian Premier League]] in 1992, and spent there 5 seasons in total over three periods. They achieved their best result of 6th place in [[2017–18 Ukrainian Premier League|2017–18]] season. Veres also reached the semi-finals of [[1993–94 Ukrainian Cup]]. The team ran into financial difficulties after the winter break of the 2010–11 season and was removed from the [[Ukrainian Second League]].Expelled from the PFL due to their financial situation. ''(April 29, 2011)'' {{cite news|url=http://pfl.ua/football_news.php?readmore=5122|title=ФК "Верес" Рівне знято зі змагань (Veres Rivne expelled from the PFL)|date=April 29, 2011|publisher=PFL|access-date=April 29, 2011|language=uk|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110505024113/http://pfl.ua/football_news.php?readmore=5122|archive-date=May 5, 2011|df=mdy-all}} It was reinstated and resumed playing in the same league in 2015.
